insert_ready_details.provider: Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council (SSHRC)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Open to domestic and international doctoral students at Canadian institutions, with agency-specific research mandate alignment.

insert_ready_details.title: Ontario Graduate Scholarship (OGS)
insert_ready_details.provider: School of Graduate Studies, University of Toronto / Ontario Ministry of Colleges, Universities, Research Excellence and Security
insert_ready_details.cycle: University-specific internal deadlines; provincial competition annually
insert_ready_details.opening_date: University-specific internal deadlines; provincial competition annually
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Open to domestic and international graduate students at participating Ontario universities with strong academic records.

insert_ready_details.title: Alberta Graduate Excellence Scholarship (AGES)
insert_ready_details.provider: Alberta Student Aid / University of Alberta
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Open to domestic and international graduate students enrolled at Alberta institutions who demonstrate outstanding academic achievement.

insert_ready_details.title: Quebec Merit Scholarship Program for Foreign Students (PBEEE)
insert_ready_details.cycle: University preselection: October 2025; FRQ final submission: December 2, 2025
insert_ready_details.opening_date: University preselection: October 2025; FRQ final submission: December 2, 2025
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: International students in research master's, PhD, postdoctoral, or short-term research programs at Quebec institutions, preselected by their host university.

insert_ready_details.title: Canada Postdoctoral Research Award (CPRA)
insert_ready_details.provider: Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council (SSHRC)
insert_ready_details.deadline: CIHR: September 16, 2026; NSERC: October 17, 2026; SSHRC: September 10, 2026
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Outstanding postdoctoral researchers of all nationalities who have completed their PhD within the last three years and are not in tenured faculty positions.

insert_ready_details.title: Canada-ASEAN Scholarships and Educational Exchanges for Development (SEED-2)
insert_ready_details.cycle: Applications open January 2026; institutional deadline March 24, 2026
insert_ready_details.opening_date: Applications open January 2026; institutional deadline March 24, 2026
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Full-time students from eligible ASEAN/Pacific/Mongolia institutions for short-term study or research exchanges at Canadian designated learning institutions.

insert_ready_details.title: Schulich Leader Scholarships
insert_ready_details.cycle: Nomination deadline: January 28, 2026; Application deadline: February 18, 2026
insert_ready_details.opening_date: Nomination deadline: January 28, 2026; Application deadline: February 18, 2026
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Canadian citizens graduating from Canadian high schools or CEGEPs who plan to study STEM at one of 20 partner universities.

insert_ready_details.title: UCAS Scholarship for International Students 2026
insert_ready_details.provider: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Not hold Chinese citizenship, valid foreign passport, friendly to China, abiding by Chinese laws and UCAS rules. Proficient in English or Chinese. PhD applicants born after Jan 1, 1991; Master's applicants born after Jan 1, 1996; Senior visiting born after Jan 1, 1981; Regular visiting born after Jan 1, 1986; Joint program applicants no age limit. Must meet UCAS international student admission criteria. Must not take up other assignments during scholarship period. Currently enrolled students in China are ineligible for degree programs at the same level.

insert_ready_details.title: CAS-ANSO Scholarship (Degree Program) 2026
insert_ready_details.provider: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Not hold Chinese citizenship, valid foreign passport, friendly to China, abiding by Chinese laws and UCAS rules. Proficient in English or Chinese. Master's applicants born after Jan 1, 1996; PhD applicants born after Jan 1, 1991. Must meet UCAS/USTC admission criteria. Must not take up other assignments during scholarship period. Must not currently be pursuing a degree at any university/institution in China. NOT allowed to apply to both USTC and UCAS simultaneously.

insert_ready_details.title: Chinese Government Scholarship for Advanced Graduate Program at Peking University (CSC Type B)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Must meet Peking University admission requirements for international students. Must have successfully submitted application for 2026 full-time self-funded graduate programs. Must not have received other Chinese government or PKU scholarships (except one-time non-renewable merit awards). Must not be a joint training program candidate. Single CSC application allowed (one major only).

insert_ready_details.title: Tsinghua University Institutional Scholarship (Tsinghua University Scholarship)
insert_ready_details.cycle: 2025/2026 and 2026/2027 (application opens Sep 30, 2025; two rounds with deadlines Nov 28, 2025 and Feb 28, 2026)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: International undergraduate applicants to Tsinghua University. No separate scholarship application required; selection based on admission materials (GPA, language scores, recommendations, study plan). Must also meet general Tsinghua admission requirements.

insert_ready_details.title: Asian Future Leaders Scholarship Program (AFLSP) 2026
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Must be non-Chinese citizens from Asia (citizens of Asian countries). Must meet Tsinghua University admission requirements for international master's students. Must demonstrate academic excellence, leadership potential, integrity, good English proficiency and presentation skills. Must not be offered other scholarships for study at Tsinghua. Must be able to attend mandatory enrichment programs at Beijing campus (not open to Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School applicants).

insert_ready_details.title: Atomic Energy Scholarship Program of China 2026
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Citizens of countries other than PRC committed to the nuclear industry for societal benefit, in good health. Holders of Bachelor's or Master's degree in relevant majors (nuclear engineering, nuclear technology, mechanics, energy, chemical engineering, physics) with strong scientific research capability. Proficiency in English. Master's applicants under 35 years old; PhD applicants under 40 years old. Preference given to those with work experience in nuclear or related fields.

insert_ready_details.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (Chinese University Program) at Fudan University 2026
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Non-Chinese citizens in good health, meeting Fudan University admission requirements. Must apply through Fudan University's international admissions system and indicate intention for CSC scholarship consideration. Must secure pre-admission from Fudan.

insert_ready_details.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (Youth of Excellence Scheme) at Fudan University 2026
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Non-Chinese citizens in good health, meeting Fudan University admission requirements. Open to youth of excellence applicants. Must apply through Fudan University's international admissions system. Must secure pre-admission from Fudan.

insert_ready_details.title: Shanghai Government Scholarship at Fudan University 2026
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Non-Chinese citizens in good health, meeting Fudan University admission requirements. Must apply through Fudan University's international admissions system and indicate intention for Shanghai Government Scholarship consideration.

insert_ready_details.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS - China Embassy, Dhaka) 2025/2026
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Bangladeshi students who are outstanding and wish to pursue degree programs or Chinese language program in Chinese universities. Must be in good health and meet university admission requirements.

insert_ready_details.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS - China Embassy, Jakarta) 2026/2027
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Indonesian citizens (non-PRC), in good mental and physical health, not Chinese citizens. China-Indonesia Scholarship in Higher Education Program. Must meet admission requirements of target universities. Applicants for English-taught programs must provide IELTS/TOEFL scores.

insert_ready_details.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS - China Embassy, Nassau) 2026/2027
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Non-Chinese citizens, in good health both mentally and physically. Applied through Chinese Embassy in Bahamas (Bahamas Program Category A, Agency Number 0441). Must submit CSCA Score Report for bachelor's degree applicants intending September 2026 enrollment. Pre-admission documents required from target universities.

insert_ready_details.title: Czech Government Scholarship – Developing Countries for AY 2027/28
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Citizens of eligible developing countries including Bangladesh, Belarus (democratic opposition), Bosnia and Herzegovina, Cambodia, Ethiopia, Gabon, Georgia, Guatemala, Honduras, Mauritania, Palestine, Ukraine, Zambia and others. Must be admitted to selected Master's or Doctoral study programmes at Czech public universities.

insert_ready_details.title: Václav Havel Bursary
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: International students admitted to Charles University whose studies are hindered or prevented by repression under totalitarian, authoritarian, or other non-democratic regimes anywhere in the world. Students from countries where human rights and freedoms are violated and discriminatory measures restrict access to education.

insert_ready_details.title: Visegrad Scholarship Program 2027
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Master's and post-Master's students and researchers in all disciplines. Applicant's citizenship must differ from the host institution's country. Study or research at accredited higher-education institutions in V4 countries (Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland, Slovakia) or other Central/Eastern European institutions.

insert_ready_details.title: CTU Scholarship for Foreign Students of English Master's Degree Study Programmes
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Foreign students enrolled in Master's study programmes at CTU who display qualities entitling them to the award. Must obtain faculty agreement and submit application through International Office to the Department of International Relations at the rectorate.

insert_ready_details.title: Danish Government Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students admitted to a Master's programme at UCPH. Must be liable for tuition fees. Automatic consideration during admission application; no separate scholarship application required.

insert_ready_details.title: Danish State Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students admitted to a Master's programme at Aarhus University. Must be liable for tuition fees. Automatic consideration during admission application; no separate scholarship application required.

insert_ready_details.title: Tuition Fee Waiver
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students admitted to a Master's or PhD programme at DTU. Must be liable for tuition fees. Automatic consideration during admission application; no separate scholarship application required.

insert_ready_details.title: International Student Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students admitted to a Master's programme at AAU. Must be liable for tuition fees. Automatic consideration during admission application; no separate scholarship application required.

insert_ready_details.title: University of Helsinki RESDOC Doctoral Researcher Positions 2026 (30 Fully Funded PhD Positions)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Early-stage researchers (less than 4 years of research experience) with a completed Master's degree, not yet holding a PhD. Must comply with EU MSCA mobility rule (not resident in Finland for more than 12 months in the past 3 years). Must propose a research topic fitting RESDOC themes: infectious diseases and antimicrobial resistance, biodiversity and nature's resilience, sustainable food and water systems, and just socio-ecological transition. English language proficiency required. Willingness to reside in Finland for full 4-year duration.

insert_ready_details.title: University-funded Doctoral Researcher Positions 2026 (Salaried PhD Positions)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Open to all disciplines. Must hold a master's level degree or equivalent qualifying for doctoral studies at the University of Helsinki. Must not already be a PhD holder. Applications accepted in all fields of study. Positions are full-time (100% employment).

insert_ready_details.title: Aalto University Excellence Scholarship (100% Tuition Fee Waiver)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students liable to pay tuition fees applying for English-taught Bachelor's or Master's programmes at Aalto University. Must meet admission requirements for the chosen programme. Merit-based and highly competitive - some programmes may award no scholarships. Application integrated with degree admission application via Studyinfo.fi.

insert_ready_details.title: Tampere University Scholarships (Tuition Fee Waiver + International Advancement Scholarship)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students required to pay tuition fees applying to English-taught Bachelor's or Master's programmes. Must demonstrate high academic achievement and motivation. Scholarship application is integrated with the degree admission application via Studyinfo.fi. Document submission deadline is typically 5-7 days after application deadline.

insert_ready_details.title: University of Oulu Tuition Fee Waivers and Early Bird Discount
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students required to pay tuition fees applying to English-taught Bachelor's or Master's programmes at the University of Oulu. Must demonstrate academic merit. No first-year scholarships available beyond Early Bird discount. Continuing student scholarships based on completing 55 ECTS credits per year including mandatory Finnish language studies (5 ECTS).

insert_ready_details.title: University of Eastern Finland (UEF) Tuition Waivers (30% or 50%)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students required to pay tuition fees. UEF offers partial tuition waivers (30% standard or 50% for selected programmes) awarded based on application scores. No full (100%) tuition waivers available through standard application. Must apply through Studyinfo.fi. Application fee applies.

insert_ready_details.title: University of Turku Tuition Fee Waivers and Early Bird Discount
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students required to pay tuition fees applying for English-taught Bachelor's or Master's programmes. No first-year tuition fee scholarships available - first-year support is only through Early Bird discount. Scholarships for continuing students awarded based on academic merit (studies completed at University of Turku). Must complete 55 ECTS credits in first year for Master's merit scholarship.

insert_ready_details.title: Åbo Akademi University Tuition Fee Scholarships (Early Commitment + Fee Waivers)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Non-EU/EEA students liable to pay tuition fees applying to English-taught Master's programmes (and some Bachelor's programmes). For 2026 intake: Early Commitment offer available (€4,000 discount for accepting study place and paying within deadline). Prior year scholarships (for students admitted before 2026): 100% or 80% tuition fee waivers.

insert_ready_details.title: Finland Scholarship (National Programme for Master's Students)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: The best non-EU/EEA applicant in each Finnish Master's programme offered through the national joint application. Awarded by the Ministry of Education and Culture based on admission score ranking. No separate application required beyond the degree application via Studyinfo.fi. Applications for January 2027 intake open in September 2026.

insert_ready_details.title: Hanken School of Economics Premium Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Students from developing countries who are degree students or alumni of Global Business School Network (GBSN) member schools. Must apply to Hanken's two-year Master's Degree programme in Economics and Business Administration. Two scholarships awarded annually. Application integrated with degree application.

insert_ready_details.title: Nokia Scholarship (ICT Doctoral Studies)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Individuals pursuing a doctoral degree in Information and Communications Technologies (ICT) or in areas supporting the development of these branches of science. Applicants should have one or more accepted publications intended for inclusion in their dissertation. Optimal time to apply when applicant has strong publication record. Must have a commitment from a professor/supervisor at a Finnish university.

insert_ready_details.title: Nokia Foundation Fellow (ICT Research Project Funding)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Applications submitted by a tenured associate or full professor (Principal Investigator) at a Finnish university. The grant finances hiring a doctoral or postdoctoral researcher to work on an innovative, high-risk/high-reward ICT research project. The PI may submit one application per call. Project is led by the professor as director.

insert_ready_details.title: Jorma Ollila Grants (Recent Doctorates - International Experience)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Finnish citizens or those with permanent residence permit in Finland who have recently completed their doctorate. Must have a master's degree minimum. Intended for Finnish researchers seeking to conduct research at a high-level foreign university or research institute. The Nokia Foundation prefers advanced doctoral researchers and especially early postdocs in ICT. Finnish citizens or permanent residents only.

insert_ready_details.title: Erasmus Mundus MARIHE Scholarship (Master in Research and Innovation in Higher Education)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Open to students from all over the world with a Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) completed in an EU/EEA country, Switzerland, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, UK, or US, OR a two-year Master's degree from these regions. All nationalities welcome. Students study at 7 partner institutions across Austria, China, Finland, Germany, Hungary, India, and Portugal over 2 years.

insert_ready_details.title: Erasmus Mundus EDISS Scholarship (Engineering of Data-intensive Intelligent Software Systems)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Open to students worldwide for the 2-year Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degree in Engineering of Data-intensive Intelligent Software Systems. Students study at 4 partner universities: Åbo Akademi University (Finland), University of the Balearic Islands (Spain), University of L'Aquila (Italy), and Mälardalen University (Sweden).

insert_ready_details.title: Erasmus Mundus European Forestry (MSc EF) Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Open to students worldwide for the 2-year Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in European Forestry. Students study forest management in 7 European countries (Austria, Finland, France, Germany, Netherlands, Romania, Spain) with cohort of international students.

insert_ready_details.title: Erasmus Mundus EMCL Scholarship (European Master's in Clinical Linguistics)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Open to students worldwide for the 2-year Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Clinical Linguistics. Offered by University of Eastern Finland (Finland), University of Ghent (Belelgium), and University of Groningen (Netherlands). Over 20 years of running history.

insert_ready_details.title: Erasmus Mundus BioCEB Scholarship (Biochemistry and Molecular Biology)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Open to students worldwide for the 2-year Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Excellence in Analytical Chemistry. Finnish partner: University of Eastern Finland. Programme covers analytical chemistry in a diverse way across partner universities.

insert_ready_details.title: Fulbright-Nokia Distinguished Chair in ICT
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: U.S. scholars/specialists in Information and Communications Technologies (ICT) to engage in research, collaboration, teaching, and guest lecturing at Finnish higher education institutions. The application is a dual process: separate applications to Fulbright grant competition and to University of Helsinki for admission.

insert_ready_details.title: France-South Africa Scholarship Programme 2027
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: South African, Lesotho or Malawian citizens admitted or applying to a French higher education institution for a Master's or PhD starting September 2027. Born on or after 1 January 1996.

insert_ready_details.title: Pasteur-Paris University (PPU) International Doctoral Program 2027
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Master's degree (or equivalent) from a non-French university in science, medicine or related fields. Typically 24-26 years old. Must not have resided in France more than 12 months in the 3 years prior to the deadline. English fluency required; French not mandatory.

insert_ready_details.title: InLife Sorbonne Université International Mobility Grants 2026-2027
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Master's students from foreign universities. No geographical restrictions. Interdisciplinary projects focusing on living systems. Host laboratory must be affiliated with a member institution of the Sorbonne University Alliance.

insert_ready_details.title: Sciences Po Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program 2027
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Citizens of an African country (or refugee status), under 35 years of age on 1 September 2026, not already holding a Master's degree, and applying to a two-year Master's program at Sciences Po for the first time.

insert_ready_details.title: Hungarian Bilateral State Scholarships
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Based on bilateral educational agreements between Hungary and partner countries; applicants must be enrolled or accepted at a Hungarian higher education institution; applications via https://scholarship.hu/; scholarship paid by receiving institution or sending country

insert_ready_details.title: Momentum MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowship
insert_ready_details.funding_summary: Employment contract with full social security
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Doctoral degree or successful thesis defense by deadline; MSCA mobility rule: max 12 months in Hungary in past 3 years; not employed by Lendület host at deadline; research at MTA Lendület/Momentum groups; up to ~17 full 36-month positions available

insert_ready_details.title: Hungarian Diaspora Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: For ethnic Hungarians and descendants living in diaspora communities outside the EU, Republic of Serbia, and Zakarpattia (Ukraine); must obtain recommendation from local Hungarian diaspora organization or diplomatic representation; application via https://apply.diasporascholarship.hu/

insert_ready_details.title: Semmelweis Pannonia In Excellence Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Foreign nationals holding student status at Semmelweis University; enrolled in English or German-taught programs; began studies September 2024 or later; NOT recipients of Stipendium Hungaricum or Hungarian Diaspora Scholarship; based on academic progress and achievements in sports/arts

insert_ready_details.title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship – Embassy Recommendation (Research Students 2027)
insert_ready_details.funding_summary: Fully funded government scholarship (tuition + stipend + airfare + insurance)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Citizens of countries with diplomatic relations with Japan. Born on or after April 2, 1992 (under 35 at program start). Must hold or expect to hold a Bachelor's degree (for Research Student/Master's) or Master's degree (for Ph.D.) by April 2027. Undergraduate applicants must have completed 12+2 with minimum 70% marks (or equivalent). English/Japanese language proficiency may be assessed. Must be in good health. Not currently holding another Japanese government scholarship.

insert_ready_details.title: Ramanujan Fellowship (AY 2026-27)
insert_ready_details.funding_summary: Fully funded research fellowship (consolidated stipend + research grant + overhead)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Open to brilliant Indian/Indian-origin scientists and engineers working abroad (not holding any permanent/tenure-track/contractual position in India) who wish to return to India. Applicants must be below 40 years of age (as of date of nomination). Must possess a Ph.D./Mastery's in Engineering or Technology/MD or equivalent with adequate professional experience. Must have a proven outstanding track record of research publications and recognitions. Must work at an S&T institution in India other than the one where the Ph.D. was pursued. Currently working abroad at the time of nomination.

insert_ready_details.title: Government of Ireland Postgraduate Scholarship Programme 2027
insert_ready_details.funding_summary: Full scholarship with stipend, fees contribution, and research costs
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Open to new entrants to a Master's or PhD programme or registered students in the first year of the degree. Applicants must hold a first-class or upper-second-class honours bachelor's degree (or equivalent). Must be affiliated with an eligible Research Body. Open to all nationalities. Must not currently or previously hold a Research Ireland scholarship (except one that enabled a master's degree).

insert_ready_details.title: Ireland Fellows Programme 2027/2028
insert_ready_details.funding_summary: Fully funded (fees, flights, accommodation, living costs, insurance)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Early to mid-career professionals from eligible countries (Africa, Asia, Latin America, Caribbean, Pacific, Palestine) with leadership potential. Must hold a relevant bachelor's degree, have required work experience, and not already hold a master's qualification. Must be in a position to take up the Fellowship in 2027/2028.

insert_ready_details.title: University of Galway Global Scholarships 2026/27
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Non-EU countries. Merit-based awards across colleges. Specific college scholarships available for Science & Engineering, Business, Public Policy & Law, etc.

insert_ready_details.title: Hardiman Research Scholarships 2026
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: High-achieving individuals commencing PhD on 1 September 2026. Must not be currently registered as a PhD student or previously awarded a PhD. Must nominate one supervisor.

insert_ready_details.title: DCU International Scholarships for Non-EU Students 2027-28
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Non-EU applicants who have received an offer to study at DCU. Automatic consideration upon application to DCU. No separate application required for most faculty scholarships. Varies by faculty: Humanities & Social Sciences, Engineering & Computing, Business, Science & Health.

insert_ready_details.title: Government of Ireland Postdoctoral Fellowship Programme 2026
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Suitably qualified postdoctoral candidates pursuing full-time research in any discipline. Must be hosted at an eligible higher education institution in Ireland.

insert_ready_details.title: Royal Society – Research Ireland University Research Fellowship 2026
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Early career postdoctoral researchers with 3-8 years of research experience since PhD (career breaks considered). Must be hosted within a Research Ireland Eligible Research Body in the Republic of Ireland.

insert_ready_details.title: Sapienza University of Rome International Scholarships 2026/2027
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: International students applying to English-taught programmes at Sapienza University of Rome. All disciplines except Medicine and Surgery.

insert_ready_details.title: University of Padua International Excellence Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: International students applying to Master's or PhD programmes at the University of Padua. All degree programmes offered.

insert_ready_details.title: University of Bologna Study Grants and Fees
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: International students applying to degree programmes at the University of Bologna. All disciplines offered.

insert_ready_details.title: ITALYOU 4th Edition - Scholarships for Foreign Teachers of Italian Language and Culture
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Foreign teachers of Italian language and culture. Must have relevant teaching experience and qualifications.

insert_ready_details.title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship 2027 – Undergraduate Students
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: High school seniors or recent graduates from countries with diplomatic relations with Japan. Age typically 17–25. Must indicate intended major. Requirements vary by Japanese diplomatic mission.

insert_ready_details.title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship 2027 – Research Students
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Graduate or postgraduate students under 35 years old with a bachelor's degree or equivalent (16 years of schooling). Open to all majors. Must explain intended field of study and benefit to Japan-home country relations.

insert_ready_details.title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship 2026 – Japanese Studies Students
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate students at a non-Japanese university majoring in Japanese language or Japanese culture. Must have studied Japanese for at least one year. Must be able to travel to Embassy of Japan in Washington, D.C. for screening.

insert_ready_details.title: JASSO Monbukagakusho Honors Scholarship for Privately-Financed International Students
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Privately financed international students enrolled or planning to enroll in eligible Japanese institutions. Must have excellent academic achievement (GPA ≥ 2.30), Japanese (JLPT N2/EJU) or English (CEFR B2) proficiency, and financial need (monthly remittance < ¥90,000).

insert_ready_details.title: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowships for Research in Japan – Standard Program (FY2027, 1st Round)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral researchers from overseas. Must have a Japanese host researcher/institution. Application submitted by host institution through JSPS Electronic Application System.

insert_ready_details.title: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowships for Research in Japan – Short-term PE (FY2027, 1st Round)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral researchers from overseas with a Japanese host researcher/institution. Short-term program for collaborative research.

insert_ready_details.title: JSPS Invitational Fellowships for Research in Japan – FY2027 (1st Round, Long-term & Short-term)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Overseas researchers invited by a Japanese host institution. Long-term and short-term programs available. Application submitted by host institution via JSPS Electronic Application System.

insert_ready_details.title: Rotary Yoneyama Memorial Scholarship 2027 (Overseas Candidates)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: International students residing outside Japan who plan to enroll at a Japanese university or graduate school in April or September/October 2027. Must have JLPT N3 or above at time of application. Must have applied to a Japanese institution and submit admission application copy. Research students not eligible.

insert_ready_details.title: NL Scholarship (formerly Holland Scholarship)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Non-EEA international students applying for a full-time bachelor's or master's programme at a participating Dutch higher education institution. Must not hold a degree from a Dutch educational institution. Must meet specific requirements of the chosen institution.

insert_ready_details.title: VU Fellowship Programme (VUFP)
insert_ready_details.funding_summary: Merit-based tuition fee waiver + living cost contribution
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Talented non-EEA/EEA students applying for a Master's programme at VU Amsterdam. Must be conditionally admitted before applying. Automatically applies for NL Scholarship when applying for VUFP.

insert_ready_details.title: Erasmus Trustfonds Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Full-time first-year Master students with excellent results from both EEA and non-EEA countries. Must have completed immigration application by May at the latest.

insert_ready_details.title: Erasmus Trustfonds Scholarship / TSH Changemaker Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Underrepresented students pursuing a Master's programme at Erasmus MC. Must apply for one of the eligible full-time Research Master's programmes (Health Sciences, Neuroscience, or Molecular Medicine). Excellent academic standard required (average grade equivalent to Dutch 8.0/10).

insert_ready_details.title: Lutfia Rabbani Scholarship Fund (LUF)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Students of Algerian, Bahraini, Egyptian, Iraqi, Jordanian, Kuwaiti, Lebanese, Libyan, Moroccan, Omani, Palestinian, Qatari, Saudi, Sudanese, Syrian, Tunisian, UAE, or Yemeni nationality. Must have official admission letter to a one-year Master's programme at Leiden University or be enrolled in second year of two-year Master's. Exceptional academic excellence and strong motivation to promote Euro-Arab dialogue required.

insert_ready_details.title: Leiden University Excellence Scholarship (LExS)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Excellent non-EEA/non-EFTA students enrolling in a full-time Leiden University Master's degree programme (exceptions: Advanced LLM programmes and MSc International Relations and Diplomography, open to all nationalities). Must not be eligible for Dutch student finance. Must be among top 10% academically.

insert_ready_details.title: Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarships
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Excellent international applicants (conditionally) admitted to one of the 2-year regular TU Delft MSc programmes (not International Joint Education Programmes). Must have bachelor's degree from outside Netherlands. Must be among top 10% of graduates. Must submit complete MSc application before scholarship deadline.

insert_ready_details.title: Wageningen University Excellence Programme
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: International MSc students from non-EU and non-EFTA countries starting an MSc programme in September 2027 with unconditional admission. High GPA of 80% or higher required. First Class honours BSc graduation or equivalent.

insert_ready_details.title: NWO Embassy Science Fellowship (ESF-NL) 2027
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: PhD graduates from Dutch research organisations (universities, universities of applied sciences, KNAW institutes, NWO institutes, Netherlands Cancer Institute, Max Planck Institute for Psycholinguistics, Naturalis, ARCNL, Princess Máxima Center, IHE Delft, TO2 institutions). Researchers with fixed PhD date also eligible if PhD obtained at fellowship start.

insert_ready_details.title: Thijssen-Schoute Fellowship 2027
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: PhD students at an advanced stage or recent PhD graduates (PhD defence no more than 3 years ago). Research in history of ideas, with special focus on 17th century and Dutch Republic.

insert_ready_details.title: KB Fellowship at NIAS 2026-2027
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Scholarly researchers with at least 3 years of research experience after PhD (on closing date) or creative practitioners with at least 3 years of independent art practice since formal graduation. Open to researchers with or without institutional affiliation.

insert_ready_details.title: Willem F. Duisenberg Fellowship 2027-2028
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Prominent, leading mid-to-late-career researchers or promising early-career talents from Netherlands or abroad. Minimum three years of post-PhD academic experience. Research in applied monetary economics, macroeconomics, or public finance.

insert_ready_details.title: Eric Bleumink Fellowship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Students from developing countries (Afghanistan, Angola, Bangladesh, Benin, Bhutan, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Cambodia, Chad, Comoros, Djibouti, Eritrea, Ethiopia, Gambia, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Haiti, Kiribati, Lesotho, Liberia, Madagascar, Malawi, Mali, Mauritania, Mozambique, Myanmar, Nepal, Rwanda, Sao Tome and Principe, Senegal, Sierra Leone, Solomon Islands, Somalia, Tanzania, Togo, Tuvalu, Uganda, Vanuatu, Yemen, Timor-Leste, South Sudan, Central African Republic, Zambia, Bolivia, Cape Verde, Congo, Ghana, Honduras, India, Korea Dem. Rep., Kyrgyzstan, Mongolia, Morocco, Nigeria, Vietnam, Uzbekistan, Ukraine, Algeria, Cameroon, Egypt, Iran, Ivory Coast, Jordan, Kenya, Micronesia, Nicaragua, Niger, Pakistan, Papua New Guinea, Philippines, Samoa, Sri Lanka, Sudan, Tajikistan, Tokelau, Tunisia, Zimbabwe, Lao PDR). Must have provisional or unconditional admission offer before February.

insert_ready_details.title: KITLV Visiting Fellowships 2026 (2nd call)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Scholars with a PhD in Social Sciences and/or Humanities carrying out research in Southeast Asian and/or Caribbean Studies. Not required to have university or research institute affiliation, but must have steady income during fellowship. Must not be a tax resident of the Netherlands.

insert_ready_details.title: Tilburg University Waiver
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Non-EEA international applicants who completed their most recent degree in one of the eligible countries (Afghanistan, Albania, Armenia, Bangladesh, Belarus, Bolivia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Burkina Faso, Cameroon, China, Colombia, Congo DR, Côte d'Ivoire, Ecuador, Egypt, Eritrea, Ethiopia, Georgia, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Iran, Iraq, Jordan, Kenya, Kosovo, Kyrgyzstan, Lebanon, Liberia, Mauritania, Mexico, Moldova, Morocco, Myanmar, Namibia, Nepal, Nigeria, North Macedonia, Pakistan, Palestine, Peru, Philippines, Serbia, Sierra Leone, Sri Lanka, Sudan, Syria, Taiwan, Tanzania, Tunisia, Türkiye, Uganda, Ukraine, Uzbekistan, Venezuela, Vietnam, Yemen). Must be first Master's at Tilburg.

insert_ready_details.title: Radboud Scholarship Programme
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Highly talented non-EEA students applying for a full-time Master's programme at Radboud University. Must meet English language requirements and have excellent academic background.

insert_ready_details.title: Orange Knowledge Programme (OKP) 2026
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Professionals from eligible countries in Africa, Asia, Latin America, and the Middle East. Must have at least 2 years of relevant work experience. Must meet admission requirements of Dutch higher education institution. Not available for students from EU/EEA countries.

insert_ready_details.title: Erasmus University Rotterdam Scholarships
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: International students applying for Master's programmes at Erasmus University Rotterdam. Multiple scholarships available with different criteria and eligibility requirements.

insert_ready_details.title: University of Amsterdam Scholarships
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: International students applying for Bachelor's or Master's programmes at UvA. Multiple scholarships available with different criteria.

insert_ready_details.title: Tulī Takes Flight Scholarships 2026
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Pacific peoples seeking to reduce financial barriers towards study or training in Aotearoa New Zealand. Open for vocational or degree-level study.

insert_ready_details.title: New Zealand Space Scholarship 2026
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: New Zealand citizens enrolled in a postgraduate degree in science, technology, engineering or mathematics at a New Zealand tertiary institution in 2026, with an interest in space and advanced aviation.

insert_ready_details.title: Tāwhia te Mana Research Fellowships 2026 — Mana Tūāpapa Future Leader Fellowship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: New Zealand citizens or permanent residents with a PhD conferred within 4 years of the closing date (on or after 9 July 2022), supported by a New Zealand-based research organisation. Must not have previously been awarded a major research grant as Principal Investigator.

insert_ready_details.title: Rhodes Scholarship for New Zealand 2026
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: New Zealand citizens or permanent residents who have spent at least 5 of the previous 10 years in NZ. Must be 18–24 on 1 October 2026 (or up to 27 if first undergraduate degree completed after 1 October 2025). Academic excellence required.

insert_ready_details.title: Ngarimu VC and 28th (Māori) Battalion Memorial Scholarships 2026–2027
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Māori students pursuing vocational or tertiary study at university, wānanga, or in vocational education and training. Values aligned with the 28th Māori Battalion.

insert_ready_details.title: Kupe Scholarship for Māori and Pacific High Achievers 2027
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Māori or Pacific descent, New Zealand citizen, permanent resident or resident visa holder. Must have completed at least one full year of an approved teaching course or be enrolled in an approved Graduate Diploma/Master of Teaching with academic excellence (B+ average or above for undergraduates).

insert_ready_details.title: University of Auckland Top Achiever Scholarship 2027
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: School leavers planning to start undergraduate study at the University of Auckland in 2027. Academic achievement and potential.

insert_ready_details.title: University of Auckland Vaka Moana Scholarship 2027
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Pacific students commencing first-year undergraduate study at the University of Auckland in 2027.

insert_ready_details.title: University of Waikato Vice-Chancellor's International Excellence Scholarship 2026
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: International students (excluding those eligible for specific regional scholarships) with an Offer of Place from the University of Waikato. Academic merit and potential to become global ambassadors.

insert_ready_details.title: University of Otago Vice-Chancellor's International Postgraduate Scholarships
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: International students commencing selected full-time postgraduate programmes at the University of Otago. Not citizens, permanent residents or resident visa holders of New Zealand or Australia. Minimum NZ B+ equivalent.

insert_ready_details.title: University of Otago International Master's Research Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: International students obtaining their first Master's qualification and undertaking a thesis-based Master's at the University of Otago. Academic merit and research potential.

insert_ready_details.title: University of Otago Doctoral Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Domestic and international students

insert_ready_details.funding_summary: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Health insurance

insert_ready_details.title: Stefan Banach Scholarship
insert_ready_details.funding_summary: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Health insurance

insert_ready_details.funding_summary: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Health insurance

insert_ready_details.funding_summary: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Health insurance

insert_ready_details.title: NAWA TOP200 Programme (Excellence Initiative)
insert_ready_details.funding_summary: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Travel allowance

insert_ready_details.title: Lane Kirkland Scholarship Program
insert_ready_details.funding_summary: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Travel + Insurance

insert_ready_details.funding_summary: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Travel + Insurance

insert_ready_details.funding_summary: Tuition waiver + Monthly stipend (subsidized by host country)

insert_ready_details.title: SAF Merit Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens or permanent residents intending to take up citizenship. Good GCE 'A' Level or IB results, Polytechnic Diploma (with Merit). Strong leadership qualities, good CCA records. Must qualify for and excel in Officer Cadet School.

insert_ready_details.title: MHA Civilian Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: All-rounded individuals passionate about strengthening Singapore's safety and security. Singapore citizens. Can choose from Generalist or Specialist roles (Commercial Affairs, Intelligence, Internal Security, Psychology).

insert_ready_details.title: Singapore Police Force Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Outstanding leadership qualities, impeccable integrity, strong interest in policing work. Singapore citizens. Open to male and female applicants.

insert_ready_details.title: PSC Undergraduate Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Strong leadership qualities and potential. Well-rounded individuals with good academic and non-academic records. Pre-university or mid-term applicants (up to penultimate year).

insert_ready_details.title: PSC Master's Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Final year undergraduate students or fresh graduates with no more than 3 years working experience. Must start Master's in immediate academic year following offer.

insert_ready_details.title: Lee Kuan Yew Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens only. Track record of leadership and achievement. Potential to excel in chosen field. No course restrictions.

insert_ready_details.title: MOE Teaching Scholarship (Full-Term)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens or PRs willing to take up citizenship. Strong passion for education service, leadership qualities. Various qualification-specific windows.

insert_ready_details.title: Singapore-Industry Scholarship (SgIS)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Good GCE A-Level, Polytechnic Diploma, IB Diploma or NUS High School Diploma. Good CCA records and leadership achievements. Passion to contribute to Singapore's strategic sectors. Three schemes: Full-Term, Mid-Term (Local), Mid-Term (Overseas).

insert_ready_details.title: SINGA - Singapore International Graduate Award
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: International graduates (all nationalities except Singapore citizens and PRs). Excellent academic results, strong research portfolio, proficiency in English.

insert_ready_details.title: A*STAR International Fellowship (AIF)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens or Singapore PRs. Completed PhD within last 4 years. No existing institutional bonds. Must have secured postdoctoral position at leading overseas institution. Two tracks: Research and Innovation.

insert_ready_details.title: National Science Scholarship (PhD)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens or other nationals intending to take up Singapore citizenship. Good class of Honours degree. Must have applied for PhD at top overseas institution. 1-year research attachment at A*STAR required before PhD.

insert_ready_details.title: A*STAR Graduate Scholarship (AGS)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Currently enrolled in Singapore autonomous university. Completed at least 1 semester. On track to excellent academic standing. Non-Singaporeans must have SPR or citizenship. Four tracks: STEM, Semiconductor, Quantum, Computing.

insert_ready_details.title: NUS Undergraduate Scholarship (incl. Global Merit, Merit, AI Talent, Sports, Performing & Visual Arts)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Strong leadership qualities, good CCA records, outstanding academic results (GCE A-Level, Polytechnic Diploma, IB, NUS High School Diploma or equivalent).

insert_ready_details.title: Nanyang Merit Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Open to all nationalities. Outstanding freshmen with strong academic results, good CCA records, good leadership qualities. Full-time undergraduate programme at NTU.

insert_ready_details.title: NTU President Award
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Students with exceptional leadership qualities, excellent co-curricular records, outstanding academic performance.

insert_ready_details.title: SMU Global Impact Scholarship Award
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Outstanding academic results, strong leadership capabilities, excellent co-curricular/community activities. Applying for full-time undergraduate degree at SMU.

insert_ready_details.title: SMU Merit Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Academic excellence, outstanding leadership qualities, commitment to community.

insert_ready_details.title: Temasek Undergraduate Overseas Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Local polytechnic graduates or graduating polytechnic students. Accepted or planning to enroll in STEM undergraduate course at overseas university (excluding Medicine and Dentistry). Gross Monthly Household Income <= S$15,000.

insert_ready_details.title: Temasek Undergraduate Local Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Polytechnic graduates enrolling in STEM programmes at Singapore Institute of Technology (SIT).

insert_ready_details.title: SUTD Undergraduate Merit Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Outstanding GCE 'A' Level, Local Polytechnic Diploma, NUS High School Diploma, IB Diploma or equivalent. Passion for technology and design.

insert_ready_details.title: SUTD Trailblazers Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens. Outstanding academic results, strong leadership capabilities, excellent co-curricular/community activities, desire to make impact on society.

insert_ready_details.title: SUSS Scholarship (Part-time Undergraduate)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Singapore citizens or permanent residents. Outstanding academic results, strong language skills, impressive CCA track record, leadership qualities, community service involvement.

insert_ready_details.title: SUSS Research Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Applicants seeking admission to PhD or Master of Applied Research in Social Sciences. At least 2nd Upper Class Honours Degree. Research aligned with SUSS focus areas.

insert_ready_details.title: NTU Short Term Scholarships
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Current undergraduates or freshmen on subsidised tuition fees who have performed well academically and meet donor criteria.

insert_ready_details.title: Swedish Institute Scholarship Pioneering Women in STEM
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Female citizens from 10 countries in Africa and Asia: Bangladesh, Indonesia, Kenya, Malaysia, Nigeria, Philippines, Rwanda, South Africa, Thailand, Vietnam. Must be admitted to an eligible master's programme in STEM fields at a Swedish university.

insert_ready_details.title: KTH Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Fee-paying international students (non-EU/EEA/Swiss) who have applied for a master's programme at KTH as their first priority via universityadmissions.se and paid the application fee. Must demonstrate academic excellence and drive to contribute to sustainable development.

insert_ready_details.title: KI Global Master's Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Tuition fee-paying students who have applied for a master's programme at Karolinska Institutet and ranked a KI programme as their first choice. Approximately 10-12 scholarships awarded annually from ~700-1000 applicants.

insert_ready_details.title: Lund University Global Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who are required to pay tuition fees. Must have applied for a degree programme at Lund University as first choice via universityadmissions.se and paid the application fee. Merit-based; financial need not considered.

insert_ready_details.title: Uppsala University Global Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who are required to pay tuition fees. Must demonstrate academic talent and have applied for a Master's programme at Uppsala University as first priority via universityadmissions.se. Highly competitive (~2% success rate).

insert_ready_details.title: Stockholm University Scholarship Scheme
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Citizens from countries outside EU/EEA/Switzerland who are required to pay tuition fees. Must be admitted to a Master's programme at Stockholm University in the first (international) admission round. Priority given to students with Stockholm University as first choice on universityadmissions.se.

insert_ready_details.title: Malmö University Master's Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Students from outside EU/EEA and Switzerland who have applied for an English-taught master's programme at Malmö University as first choice, been admitted, and are required to pay tuition fees. Must have applied in the first admissions round and paid the application fee.

insert_ready_details.title: Lund University African Research Universities Alliance (ARUA) Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Students who have been enrolled at an ARUA member university in Africa (including University of Cape Town, University of Ghana, University of Nairobi, University of Lagos, etc.) and are citizens of a country outside the EU/EEA required to pay tuition fees. Must have applied to Lund University as first choice via universityadmissions.se.

insert_ready_details.title: KTH One-Year Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Current KTH master's programme students who are fee-paying and perform strongly during their first year. Not available for joint or EIT master's programmes.

insert_ready_details.title: KTH India Scholarship
insert_ready_details.funding_summary: Full tuition waiver + monthly living allowance
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Indian applicants admitted to a master's programme at KTH. Applicants from Mumbai and Pune receive priority under the foundation rules, but the scholarship remains open to eligible Indian applicants from other regions. Very competitive (one award offered in 2026).

insert_ready_details.title: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Outstanding Master's applicants (no MAS). Must have very good Bachelor's results (top 10% = grade A, self-assessed). Not already enrolled in a Master's at ETH Zurich or holding a Master's degree. Must apply within the first application window.

insert_ready_details.title: EPFL Bachelor Excellence Fellowships
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Holders of a Swiss high-school maturity diploma or Swiss vocational maturity diploma undertaking the CMS. Outstanding results and engagement in school and extracurricular activities.

insert_ready_details.title: SNF Postdoc.Mobility
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Researchers who have completed a doctorate (PhD, MD-PhD) or medical studies. Submission up to 3 years after doctoral exam (PhD); up to 8 years after state examination for medical researchers. Swiss citizenship/permit or degree from Swiss institution required (no prior postdoctoral position abroad for non-Swiss).

insert_ready_details.title: SNF Ambizione
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers with a PhD (or medical studies) who wish to conduct, manage and lead an independent project at a Swiss higher education institution. Max 4 years after completing PhD. Must have Swiss nationality, hold a Swiss degree, or have carried out research in Switzerland for at least 12 months after doctorate.

insert_ready_details.title: SNF Starting Grants
insert_ready_details.funding_summary: Grant (salary + project funds up to CHF 1M)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Researchers with a doctorate and several years of research experience (2–8 years after PhD). Must not yet have achieved the objective of leading their own research project and team. Must have a Swiss link (Swiss nationality, Swiss degree, or at least 2 years research in Switzerland at 80% FTE).

insert_ready_details.title: UZH Student Financial Aid Office – Scholarships
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: First-degree programmes only. International Bachelor's students: eligible after earning 55 ECTS credits. International Master's students: eligible only if they hold a Swiss Bachelor's degree. Parents' taxable income must not exceed CHF 86,000 (net worth under CHF 300,000). All other financing sources must be exhausted.

insert_ready_details.title: EPFL Social Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: EPFL students in difficult financial situations. Swiss/C-permit/refugee students: from 1st year propaedeutic (or CMS in exceptional cases). International students: after completing at least one year at EPFL and successful completion of first-year cycle. Last resort after cantonal scholarships and other funding sources are exhausted.

insert_ready_details.title: Hans Wilsdorf Foundation Scholarship (EPFL)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: International students: after successful completion of first year and at least one year at EPFL, residing in Canton of Geneva. Swiss/C-permit/refugee/Swiss secondary certificate: from CMS, residing in Canton of Geneva or applied for cantonal scholarship (SBPE). Managed under same criteria as EPFL social scholarships.

insert_ready_details.title: UZH Hardship Loan
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Enrolled at UZH in acute financial emergency without any debt. Must plausibly guarantee repayment within six months. Short-term bridge for financial gaps (e.g., waiting for cantonal scholarship).

insert_ready_details.title: MOE Huayu Enrichment Scholarship (HES)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Foreign persons at least 18 years old, graduated from secondary school or post-secondary level, excellent academic record, good moral character. Not open to ROC passport holders or those currently studying Chinese in Taiwan.

insert_ready_details.title: MOE Short Term Research Award (STRA)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: International scholars (excluding mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao) who are PhD students at overseas approved universities or postdoctoral fellows. Must not hold ROC passport, not currently in Taiwan, not receiving other Taiwan government financial assistance, and not have received STRA within last 5 years.

insert_ready_details.title: NYCU International Student Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Current NYCU international students who have not received Taiwan government scholarships. Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.5 for graduate students and 3.0 for undergraduate students. Not eligible if currently receiving government-funded scholarships or holding working VISA/ARC.

insert_ready_details.title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program 2027-2028
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Citizens of participating countries (160+). Applicants apply through their home-country U.S. Embassy or Fulbright Commission. Must hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent. For master's/doctoral study or research in the U.S. English proficiency required.

insert_ready_details.title: Fulbright U.S. Student Program 2027-2028
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: U.S. citizens or permanent residents enrolled in or applying to U.S. undergraduate or graduate programs. Apply through campus Fulbright Program Adviser. Must not have extensive prior U.S. experience for certain awards.

insert_ready_details.title: Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program 2027-2028

insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Mid-career professionals from eligible countries. Bachelor's degree required. Minimum 5 years full-time professional experience. Demonstrated leadership and public service commitment. Limited prior U.S. experience. English proficiency.

insert_ready_details.title: East-West Center Graduate Degree Fellowship 2027
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Citizens or permanent residents of the United States, or citizens of Asia-Pacific countries. Admission to University of Hawai'i at Manoa graduate program required by December 1. Priority given to applicants with commitment to Asia-Pacific region.

insert_ready_details.title: AAUW International Fellowships 2026-2027
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Women who are NOT U.S. citizens or permanent residents. Full-time study in STEM fields at accredited U.S. institution. Minimum GPA 3.5 on a 4.0 scale. Must begin program on or before September 15, 2027 and complete on or after April 30, 2028. TOEFL iBT 79 / IELTS 6.5 / Cambridge 176 / Duolingo DET 120.

insert_ready_details.title: Rotary Peace Fellowship 2027-2028
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Experienced peacebuilders from any country. Strong commitment to peace and conflict resolution. Proficiency in language of instruction at host university. Competitive selection by Rotary Foundation. Up to 170 fellows selected annually.

insert_ready_details.title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP) 2026
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Citizens of eligible developing countries or Japanese nationals. Must be admitted to or enrolled in a participating master's or PhD program in a development-related field outside home country. Minimum 3 years full-time paid development-related employment since bachelor's degree. Bachelor's degree earned at least 3 years before application deadline.

insert_ready_details.title: Benjamin A. Gilman International Scholarship (Fall 2026 Cycle)

Studying or interning abroad on credit-bearing program starting between December 1, 2026 and October 31, 2027. Critical language study eligible for additional $3,000; STEM research eligible for additional $1,000.

insert_ready_details.title: Boren Awards 2027-2028 (Scholarships and Fellowships)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: U.S. citizens. Undergraduates or graduate students in any field. Commitment to national security and language/cultural study abroad. Preference for study of less commonly taught languages and critical regions. Must study abroad for at least one semester.

insert_ready_details.title: Phi Kappa Phi Fellowship 2026
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Active Phi Kappa Phi members (dues paid) or accepted members initiated by June 30, 2026. Seeking full-time enrollment in graduate/professional school beginning between May 1, 2026 and February 1, 2027. Not more than 9 graduate semester credits completed at application deadline. International students and accredited international institutions eligible.

insert_ready_details.title: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program (GRFP)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: U.S. citizens, nationals, or permanent residents. Graduate students in STEM fields or those pursuing research-based master's or doctoral degrees at accredited U.S. institutions. No more than 2 years of graduate study completed at application deadline.

insert_ready_details.title: Harvard College Need-Based Financial Aid 2027-2028
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: All applicants regardless of citizenship. Need-blind admissions for all applicants including international. International students eligible for same aid as U.S. students. CSS Profile and IDOC required. FAFSA required for U.S. citizens/permanent residents.

insert_ready_details.title: Yale College Need-Based Financial Aid 2027-2028
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: All applicants regardless of citizenship. Need-blind admissions. International students must indicate financial aid interest on admission application. CSS Profile not required for admissions/financial aid unless requested by office.

insert_ready_details.title: MIT Undergraduate Financial Aid for International Students 2026-2027
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: All applicants including international students. Need-blind, need-based, full-need for all students regardless of citizenship. International students follow same process as domestic. CSS Profile and IDOC required.

insert_ready_details.title: UT Austin International Student Scholarships (Spring 2027 and Fall 2027)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: International students meeting eligibility criteria for specific scholarships. Apply via LASSO university-wide scholarship system using keyword 'ISSS'. Must be admitted or enrolled at UT Austin.

insert_ready_details.title: University of Chicago International Scholarships for Undergraduates
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: International students applying for undergraduate admission. Need-blind admissions for international students. CSS Profile and IDOC required. Demonstrates full financial need for all admitted students.

insert_ready_details.title: Carnegie Mellon University Africa Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Young African citizens committed to using technical education to benefit their communities. Demonstrated financial need. Strong academic performance. Bachelor's degree or final year student. Programs: MSIT, MSECE, MSEAI.

insert_ready_details.title: Google PhD Fellowship Program 2027 (anticipated)
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Full-time PhD students in eligible research areas (AI/ML, systems, security, quantum, HCI, etc.). Must be nominated by eligible university; direct student applications not accepted. Available across multiple regions worldwide.

insert_ready_details.title: Trinity University International Academic Scholarships and Financial Aid
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: International undergraduate applicants. Automatically awarded at time of admission. No separate scholarship application. No undergraduate application fee. Apply through Common Application.

insert_ready_details.title: JWU Global Full Tuition Scholarship
insert_ready_details.eligibility_summary: Non-U.S. citizen incoming undergraduate full-time students. Must be invited to apply through JWU Admissions Portal after completing undergraduate application by Early Action 2 deadline (January 4, 2026). Demonstrated leadership through extracurricular, volunteer, or entrepreneurial activities. Must submit Global Impact Statement and two letters of recommendation.
